chunks: From him, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi ʿAbdillah عليه السلام; and Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari and more than one person, from Abi ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If you doubt in the maghrib prayer, then repeat; and if you doubt in the fajr prayer, then repeat.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the fajr prayer, the dawn obligatory salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib prayer, the sunset obligatory salat (prayer)
key_terms.شَكَكْتَ: you became doubtful during the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should one do if doubt occurs in the maghrib or fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer), specifically in the maghrib and fajr prayers. It instructs that when doubt occurs in either of these two prayers, the prayer is to be repeated.
